verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is Retell's transcription-mode endpointing setting: a low or higher endpointing value traded against latency. That is a tunable silence threshold, which is an adjacent control rather than the model-based end-of-turn detection the story asks for. Missing for 10: any documented model-based or semantic turn-detection capability, configuration for handling slow speakers beyond endpointing thresholds, and hands-on corroboration that the agent avoids talking over users.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use model-based end-of-turn detection beyond simple VAD silence timeouts so the agent doesn't talk over slow speakers

citations.quote: optimize for accuracy: uses the results with a higher endpointing setting
